newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni shares slide on crown fears.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni shares slide on crown fears.

text.p: Shares in the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., fell sharply on the Prague bourse on Monday led by uncertainty about the Czech crown and interest rate policy, dealers said.

At 1005 GMT Komercni was down 96 crowns, 4.9 percent to 1,842. "Everybody is scared and worried about what foreigners will do and the next steps of the Czech National Bank (CNB)," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
The CNB hiked the repo rate to 45 percent on overnight operations from 12.9 percent on Monday after raising the Lombard rate on Friday afternoon to 50 percent from 14 percent.

Although the crown steadied after the CNB moves, dealers said there was still uncertainty as to whether the central bank would win its battle against speculative pressure for a devalutaion in the longer term.
